He's been attacking the cargo shipments.|Jyn Erso and Cassian Andor|}} The '''''Dauntless''''' was an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] that was in service of the [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[Star Destroyer]] was stationed above [[Jedha City]] in [[1 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the [[Battle on Jedha]] to [[1 BBY]]. after [[Imperial Intelligence]] claimed a single [[destroyer]] would shut down any resistance to the Empire's presence on Jedha.{{InsiderCite|197|Probing the Galaxy: Imperial Reconnaissance Report}} Instead, the conflict continued. The destroyer [[Protocol 13|left]] soon after the [[Battle on Jedha]] so that the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] could commence a [[Destruction of Jedha City|test fire]] of its [[superlaser]] on the [[city]]. {{Ship-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The ''Dauntless'' first appeared in [[canon]] in the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', although it was not named. It was later identified as the ''Dauntless'' in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'', a book written to accompany the film, written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]. It first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of Maelstrom'']], a [[roleplaying game]] book written by [[Ray Winninger]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1989]].[[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of Maelstrom'']] ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Dauntless (Imperial I-class)}} *[[Guardians of the Whills (novel)|''Guardians of the Whills'']] *{{Andor|Jedha, Kyber, Erso}} *''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (novelization)|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' novelization]] {{Ab|Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (audiobook)}} *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel]]'' {{Ab|Star Wars: Rogue One: A Junior Novel (audiobook)}} *[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Rogue One: A Star Wars Story'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] *[[Rogue One Adaptation 1|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 1]] *[[Rogue One Adaptation 2|''Rogue One Adaptation'' 2]] {{Co}} ==Sources== *''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' *''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' {{1stID|''Dauntless''}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|55|Highlights of the Saga}} *''[[Star Wars: Absolutely Everything You Need to Know, Updated and Expanded]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]'' *{{Destiny|set=Across the Galaxy|cardname=Imposing Presence|link=http://swdestinydb.com/card/08026}} {{Po}} *''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' *''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |cs=Dauntless (třída Imperial I) |de=Dauntless (Imperium-II-Klasse)#kanon |es=Intrépido |fr=Dauntless (Impérial I) |ja=ドーントレス（インペリアルI級） |ka=უშიშარი (იმპერიული I-ის კლასი) }} [[Category:Imperial I-class Star Destroyers]] [[Category:Starships of the Galactic Empire]]
